## At a glance

- **Contest.** The Party against five goblin arsonists and a spreading fire.
- **At risk.** The oil store, the warehouses on Pier Row and anyone in the eel sheds.
- **Where.** Pier Row in [[Saltwick]].
- **Opposition.** Five [[Goblin Warrior]] hired hands of [[The Reedrunners]].

> [!narration] Opening
> Smoke rolls out of the warehouse door before you hear the crackle. A goblin runs past with a torch in each hand, laughing. Barrels stand in a row along the wall, and one is already burning at the bung. The flames climb the plank wall toward the rafters. On the next roof a shortbow string sings. Someone in the eel sheds is shouting for help, and the harbor bell starts to ring.

## Play

### Stakes

If the oil burns, the lamp at [[Gullhook Lighthouse]] cannot be lit with clean oil for days. If the fire reaches the eel sheds, at least a dozen people are trapped.

### Pressure

- **Round 1.** One barrel burns. A creature that starts its turn in burning ground takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.
- **Round 3.** The fire reaches the second row of barrels and blocks the warehouse door.
- **Round 5.** The rafters start to fall. A creature under them makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage on a failure.

### Terrain

Pier Row is narrow wet planking with barrels along one side and the channel on the other. The warehouse is one room 30 feet by 40 feet with a raised loft. The roofs of the next two buildings are 10 feet higher and can be reached by a stack of crates.

### Checks

- Rolling a burning barrel into the channel takes a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check.
- Reaching the roof by the crates takes a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
- Calming the trapped workers in the eel sheds takes a DC 11 Charisma (Persuasion) check.

## Encounter

### Battlefield

The fight covers the warehouse, the pier and the roofs of the buildings on either side. Water is 6 feet down, at the pier edge.

### Creatures

![[Goblin Warrior#Statblock]]

Five Goblin Warriors stand ready. Two hold torches at the warehouse and two aim shortbows from the roof. The fifth watches the door.

### Balance

Five Goblin Warriors are worth 250 XP. That is under the Low budget of 450 XP for three level 3 characters. The fire supplies the rest of the pressure, so the goblins should flee when three are down or when the rafters fall.

## Depth

### Hidden truths

- The goblins wear a green thread on the wrist, which marks Reedrunner hands. The Party can learn this by checking a captured goblin.

### Threads

- [[Reedrunner Tithe]]: the crew acts on orders from [[Ilse Corran]].

### Spotlight

- [[Odalys Ferro]] can save the trapped workers by keeping calm and casting healing spells on the burned.
